review_scope: Read-only TC review of the exact H2 schema execution contract v3, its pinned ledger, tests and migration boundary. No tests, migrations, database or service were executed.

verifications.evidence: The tenth literal case exercises the pinned Node snapshot creator/bridge with profile_version U+D800 and an ordinary scalar project_id; it asserts the exact escaped profile_version_json and raw record bytes, then imports/grants the catalog record and submits an ASCII-escaped CreateJob request through the actual G4 HTTP app. It proceeds through separate dispatcher/projector SCRAM connections and requires read_activation followed by project_activation status applied with the same job at QUEUED revision 1.

The new case keeps seed_catalog_and_eligibility’s frozen G4-clock grant for HTTP acceptance and inserts a separate owner-controlled grant bounded around actual PostgreSQL clock_timestamp() for SQL activation. The fixtures do not assume the G4 frozen clock equals the database clock.

The contract and SQL change remove redundant JSONB decoding of the already hash-checked, owner-imported snapshot record. The test now asserts profile_catalog table UPDATE/DELETE denial for runtime/operator/dispatcher/projector, all nine column-level UPDATE denials, and real WHERE-false UPDATE/DELETE failures for each SCRAM-authenticated service role. Existing owner-import/bridge validation remains the producer boundary.
The case asserts the initial all-NULL tuple, partial shapes rejected by named binding_start_window_shape CHECK with unchanged row, and the valid full tuple through record_start_attempt.

Contract and ledger agree on 351 archived cases plus ten fixed H2 cases (361 total), four phases, no skip/error/xfail, per-case limits and lifecycle evidence. The contract limits its claim to a partial SQL foundation; actual Temporal integration, H1 rerun and original AT acceptance remain pending.
